column1: # THE PRODUCTION CONSUMERS OF EVERY CANDIDATE-BEARING SURFACE.
# A candidate is production-reachable only if it appears here with a
# caller that is itself reachable from the compiler entry point

column6: The switch-case arm constructor is reached from parseStatement, which is reached from parseCompoundStatementInternal and parseCaseLabel
The default-arm constructor is reached from parseStatement, which is reached from parseCompoundStatementInternal and parseDefaultStatement
The compound-statement body loop is reached from parseCompoundStatement, which is reached from parseStatement and parseFunctionDef
The keyword dispatch switch is the entry of every keyword statement
The compound-assignment classifier is reached from the expression loop
The inverse operator map is reached from the binary-operator diagnostic
The format-spec counter is reached from the printf format check
The format-argument index table is reached from the printf format check
The assignment-operator predicate is reached from the transpiler's comparison rewrite
The pointer-operator predicate is reached from the pointer-arithmetic type check
The class-or-union predicate is reached from the class-field lookup, and from src/parser.c:537 and :585
The comparison-operator predicate is reached from the transpiler's comparison rewrite
The range-operator predicate is reached from the IR range-loop construction (src/ir.c:507,509) and from the x86 backend (src/x86.c:1357,1359)
The function-name normalisation is reached from the transpiler (src/transpiler.c:1512)
The goto-label composition is reached from the KW_GOTO arm of parseStatement
The asm return scan is reached from the function-definition parser
